decisions.reason: The drawing-format and delivery-sequence effects are already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; no additional or corrected Event is required.
The 3D file-format decision does not change dimension annotations; the separate dimension clause in the same message is already represented in this candidate's history.
Changing the required 3D delivery formats does not alter the established drawing layout, numbering, or view-style conventions.
The export-format decision does not change the bushing, piston-rod guidance, clearance, retention, or hole arrangement.
The export-format decision does not change the welded-lug geometry, fabrication sequence, angular spacing, or face-finishing rules.
